mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 77 degrees at Verona Community Park, and we are currently seeing a Waxing Gibbous moon phase.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects, and residents should also be aware that new sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently approved to ensure our city infrastructure remains self-supporting.

Today offers plenty of local fun, including the Dane County Farmers Market, live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out the Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
On August 15, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a vehicle swerving on the road, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM, so stop by for a treat, or visit the Kona Ice truck at the Verona Area High School football game starting at 6 PM tonight.
